# Kennedy Waters & Woodland

> Four self-catering holiday rentals on a working farm in Blithbury, Staffordshire, England, near Cannock Chase. Direct booking via Hospitable. Properties designed by Lia Gold of BBC's Interior Design Masters with Alan Carr.

## Properties

- [Reindeer Lodge](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/reindeer-lodge.html): Timber lodge sleeping 6 in 2 bedrooms with private wood-fired hot tub on covered decking, wood-burning stove. Pets welcome.
- [The Cottage](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/cottage.html): Two-bedroom cottage sleeping 6 with flexible bedding. Pet-friendly. Secure bike storage. Close to Cannock Chase cycling trails.
- [The Den](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/the-den.html): Small-family stay sleeping 3 with a single bed hidden in a magical loft den for children. Designed by Lia Gold.
- [The Farmhouse](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/farmhouse.html): Beautifully restored 6-bedroom farmhouse sleeping 12 with wood-fired hot tub and sauna. Three bathrooms plus separate WC. Pets welcome.

## Discover

- [About the farm](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/about.html): The story of Kennedy Waters & Woodland and the working farm setting.
- [The local area](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/area.html): Cannock Chase walks, local pubs, days out, fishing — a guide to the surrounding area.
- [On-site fishing pond](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/fishing.html): Private fishing pond available at no extra cost to all guests.
- [Get in touch](https://kennedywatersandwoodland.co.uk/contact.html): Send us a message with any questions about the properties or your stay.

## Key facts

- Location: Blithbury, Staffordshire, England, near Cannock Chase
- Setting: Working farm with sheep grazing in surrounding fields and an unfenced fishing lake
- Sleeping capacity: 3 to 12 per property (3, 6, 6, and 12 across the four)
- Check-in: 3pm via secure self check-in lockbox
- Check-out: 10am
- Pets: Welcome at Reindeer Lodge, The Cottage, and The Farmhouse with a pet fee per stay
- Parking: Free on-site at every property (2 to 6 car capacity depending on property)
- Booking: Direct via the booking widget on each property page, powered by Hospitable
- Designer: All four properties designed by Lia Gold (BBC Interior Design Masters with Alan Carr)
